Chief_Complaint.content: Patient reports a really bad tummy ache in the lower abdomen.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Lower abdominal pain started a few days ago and is worsening.
Pain is located in the lower abdomen, midline, mainly below the umbilicus.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Location: lower abd, midline, mainly below umbilicus

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Pain is constant in duration.
Pain severity is rated 8 out of 10.

History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Vaginal bleeding: light pink spotting; different from period

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Associated symptom of very small amount of vaginal discharge.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: History of constipation for one week last week, now improved.
